mines.mine_notes: Underground gold/silver mine (Ayacucho, southern Peru); operating since June 2015; flagship asset. 1,372,800 t ore processed. Cash cost on gold co-product basis; AISC $1,732/oz Au Eq (or $20.9/oz Ag Eq at 83x ratio).

Underground silver/gold mine (Santa Cruz, Argentina); operating since 2007; operated by Hochschild (51%), partner McEwen Mining 49%. Figures are Hochschild-attributable (51%); 100% mine production: 3,625 koz Ag, 76.97 koz Au (705,426 t). Cash cost $26.4/oz Ag co-product; AISC $2,520/oz Au Eq (100% basis).

Open pit gold mine (Goiás, Brazil); first production May 2024. Challenging 2025: heavy rainfall, contractor issues, processing plant suspended ~1 month for maintenance/upgrades; turnaround plan in progress with new Brazil management. 1,424,031 t ore processed. Cash cost on gold co-product basis; AISC $3,697/oz Au Eq.
Development project (Tocantins, Brazil); installation licence awarded; engineering studies ongoing (Ausenco). Reserve prices from 2024 assumptions (Au $1,750/oz).
Underground silver/gold mine (Ayacucho, Peru); on temporary care and maintenance since December 2023; Royropata project nearby with MEIA in progress. No 2025 production or reserves reported.

notes: FY2025 attributable production: 311,509 gold equivalent oz (221.44 koz gold, 7,475 koz silver); 25.9 moz silver equivalent. Au/Ag ratio 83x for 2025. Attributable AISC from operations $2,138/oz Au Eq ($25.7/oz Ag Eq). Adjusted EBITDA US$583.7M; revenue US$1,208.6M. Reserves as at Dec 31, 2025 (JORC): attributable 2,306.6 koz Au, 21.5 moz Ag, 212.9 moz Ag Eq / 2,565 koz Au Eq. Reserve price assumptions: Inmaculada/Mara Rosa Au $2,250/oz, Ag $27.0/oz; San José Au $2,750/oz, Ag $31.0/oz. 2025 brownfield exploration added 1.7 Moz Au Eq to resources. Note: San José mine-level production shown on 100% basis in AR; attributable figures used here.
